title: Waqeyaate karbala hum kya
body:
Waaqayat e karbala hum kya suaayein aapko
Rote hai mehdi imam har wo din har raat ko
1. Kaisa dulha kaisi dulhan, kaisi ye shaadi huwi
Karbala ke dasht mein ye kaisi barbadi huwi
Shaadi ke ghar me hai maatam, kya sunaayein aapko
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Girte hai uthte hai sarwar, kuch nazar aata nahi
Laasha e akbar kahan hai koi batlaata nahi
Aagayi’n khaime se zainab, kya sunaayein aapko
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Tukdhe tukdhe hogaya saara badan abbas ka
Isliye aaya na laasha hazrat e abbas ka
Maraya hai shere haider, kya sunaayein aapko
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ab bacha koi nahi hai haathon par besheer hai
Paani ke badle me dekho hurmula ka teer hai
Chid gaya hai halq e asghar kya sunaayein aapko
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Baad e sarwar zainab o kulsoom par mushkil ye thi
Ghash me the wo abid e muztar, behan sholo me thi
Jal gaya bachchi ka kurta, kya sunaayein aapko
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Jalti reti par litaaya asghar e masoom ko
Na mila ek boond paani asghar e masoom ko
Reh gaya bachcha tadhapkar , kya sunaayein aapko
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Jo khuda ke hai wo bande, matam e sarwar me hai
Murtuza tu hind me hai, aur ye dil karbal me hai Phir bulalo jald moula, kya sunaayein aapko
Kalaam : Janaab Murtuza Ali Sahab
